note: Recast from the original description of the new species by Ahmad (1965), the original in English; the queen (dealate of the alate) and the soldier are described, the worker is not; figure 58 (alate: head and pronotum, head in lateral view, mandibles) and figure 59 (soldier: head and pronotum, head in lateral view, postmentum, antenna, hind leg) are not translated.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark reddish brown; a pale eye-spot-like patch below the lateral end of the postclypeus; postclypeus much paler than the head, pale brownish; anteclypeus white; labrum pale yellow; pronotum slightly paler than the head, without a reddish tinge; mesonotum and metanotum dark brown; pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum each with a median white longitudinal stripe; abdominal tergites and sternites brown; legs brownish yellow. Head with numerous short hairs and scattered long setae; postclypeus with several short hairs and long setae; labrum sparsely hairy; pronotum as densely hairy as the head. Head nearly subcircular, wider than long when the mandibles are excluded, with a large subtriangular white patch in the middle of the dorsum; the Y suture is visible, its lateral arms less distinct than the median arm. Eyes medium-sized and convex, nearly circular, less than half their diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli small, broadly oval, 1.5 times their major diameter from the eye. Postclypeus moderately arched, about half as long as wide. Anteclypeus trapezoidal. Labrum dome-shaped. Mandible shape as in figure 58. Antenna 15 segments; segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 4, about 2 times its segment 3. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the middle of the anterior margin slightly raised and without a notch; lateral margins broadly rounded; middle of the posterior margin weakly concave. Tarsi 3-segmented. Measurements of the queen (morphotype): head length (to the labral tip) 1.97 mm, head length (to the lateral mandibular bases) 1.06 mm, head width 1.58 mm, eye major diameter 0.33 mm, eye minor diameter 0.32 mm, distance from the lower margin of the eye 0.13 mm, ocellus length 0.11 mm, ocellus width 0.10 mm, ocellus to eye 0.17 mm, postclypeus length 0.15 mm, postclypeus width 0.33 mm, pronotum length 0.85 mm, pronotum width 1.43 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown with a reddish tinge, slightly paler in the middle of the dorsum; anterior half of the anteclypeus white, posterior half brownish; labrum brownish yellow, whitish at the tip; mandibles reddish brown, slightly paler at the base; antenna pale brown; pronotum smoky brown on the margins, yellowish brown elsewhere; mesonotum and metanotum paler than the pronotum; abdominal tergites yellowish brown, the posterior tergites paler; thorax and abdominal tergites with a median white longitudinal stripe on the dorsum. Anterior half of the head with numerous short hairs and scattered long setae, the pilosity decreasing backwards, the posterior third hairless; labrum with several setae; anterior third of the postmentum with several setae and short hairs; pronotum sparsely hairy; abdominal tergites and sternites with long setae. Head nearly rectangular, the Y suture faintly visible. Anteclypeus much wider than long. Labrum small, wider than long; lateral margins nearly parallel; anterolateral corners broadly rounded; tip truncate. Mandibles stout, wide at the base; tips incurved; each mandible with one prominent wide tooth, situated near the middle; the right mandible with a minute projection behind the tooth. Postmentum flat, 2.5 times its maximum width in length, the narrowest part slightly below the middle. Antenna 14 segments; segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3; segment 4 and segment 3 subequal. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin with an indistinct notch; lateral lobes prominent, projecting forward; posterior margin convex, without a notch. Tarsi 3-segmented. Measurements of 2 soldiers (holotype/paratype): head length (to the lateral mandibular bases) 2.28/2.23 mm, head width (at the mandibular bases) 1.75/1.56 mm, head width at the posterolateral ends of the antennal carinae 1.79/1.63 mm, maximum head width 1.92/1.74 mm, left mandible length 1.43/1.43 mm, distance from the marginal tooth of the left mandible to the apical tooth 0.62/0.65 mm, postmentum length 1.30/1.19 mm, maximum postmentum width 0.52/0.46 mm, minimum postmentum width 0.33/0.31 mm, pronotum length 0.65/0.65 mm, pronotum width 0.96/0.93 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is easily distinguished from S. cyclops: this species has a Y suture, differently shaped ocelli that lie much farther from the eye, and a different pronotum shape. The soldier differs from S. sinhalensis in the dense pilosity of the anterior half of the head and the broad base of the mandibular teeth.
